'''Academia Analitica''' is a [[learned society]] for the development of [[logic]] and [[analytic philosophy]] based in [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. It was founded in 2007 at the Faculty of Philosophy of the [[University of Sarajevo]]. The society's founder and president is [[Nijaz Ibrulj]] (University of Sarajevo). The members of Academia Analitica take interest in analytic philosophy and research in the fields of logic, [[philosophy of language]], [[philosophy of science]], [[mathematics]], [[computer science]], and other analytic and deductive sciences.<ref name="aanalitica">{{cite web|url=http://www.academia-analitica.org:80//index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=12&Itemid=14 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090323095230/http://www.academia-analitica.org//index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=12&Itemid=14 |url-status=dead |archive-date=2009-03-23 |title=O UDRUŽENJU |accessdate=2010-03-22 }}</ref>

The society also takes part in several long-term projects, such as creating a [[chrestomathy]] of texts dealing with [[philosophical logic]] and establishing a journal called ''The Logical Foresight''.<ref name="lforesight">{{cite web|url=http://www.academia-analitica.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=19:the-logical-foresight&catid=2:statiki-textovi |title=Logical Foresight Homepage |accessdate=2010-03-22 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20100628123229/http://academia-analitica.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=19%3Athe-logical-foresight&catid=2%3Astatiki-textovi |archivedate=2010-06-28 }}</ref>
